# Erdos.p789 — Erdős problem 789

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/789
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/789.lean`, theorem `erdos_789.variants.sq`, AMS 5).

Let $h(n)$ be maximal such that if $A\subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ with $\lvert A\rvert=n$
then there is $B\subseteq A$ with $\lvert B\rvert \geq h(n)$ such that if
$a_1+\cdots+a_r=b_1+\cdots+b_s$ with $a_i,b_i\in B$ then $r=s$.

Is $h(n) = \Theta(\sqrt{n})$?

## Statement
(fun n ↦ (subsetSumThreshold n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] fun n ↦ √n

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
